name: Bennett Henderson
bio: a Representative from Tennessee; born in Bedford, Bedford County, Va., February 23, 1782; moved to Tennessee; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Fourteenth Congress (March 4, 1815-March 3, 1817); farmer; died on October 12, 1849, in Fayette County, Tenn.; interment at Somerville Cemetery, Somerville, Tenn.
